data.description: Decorate any <button> or <a> as a clipboard-copy trigger. Apply to elements that copy a literal string or the contents of another element.

data-aed-copy-text.description: Literal text to copy. Mutually exclusive with `copy-from`.

data-aed-copy-from.description: CSS selector of the element whose textContent should be copied.

data-aed-copy-label.description: Initial button label (text content used if absent).

data-aed-copy-copied-label.description: Label shown briefly after a successful copy.

data-aed-copy-variant.description: Visual variant. 'icon' renders an icon-only button.
